scientific_role: post-hoc structural-shift audit of a frozen selective screener; not prospective OOD validation and not model redevelopment
primary_questions: Does ECFP4 distance from the frozen ABCB1 reference chemistry identify higher forced-binary error or performance loss?
As structural distance increases, does frozen v0.4 reduce coverage and retain a more reliable accepted subset than forcing its abstentions?

direct_model_reference.source: training_rows in the frozen v0.3 direct-model package

direct_evidence_panel.role: full matched-parental evidence chemistry, including rows excluded from model training

joint_model_reference.construction: connectivity-deduplicated union of the 443 primary and 63 direct-model structures
joint_model_reference.role: primary structural-shift reference for OOD metrics

joint_evidence_reference.construction: connectivity-deduplicated union of the 443 primary and all 84 direct-evidence structures

evaluation_sets.primary: Biogen/Fang 2023 identity-clean connectivity-collapsed MDR1-MDCK rows; expected n=2624
evaluation_sets.sensitivity: same rows after reference-Murcko-scaffold exclusion; expected n=2562
evaluation_sets.endpoint: continuous log10 MDR1-MDCK efflux ratio and frozen ER>=2 weak binary sensitivity label

distance_definitions.S1: maximum Tanimoto similarity to a reference space
distance_definitions.S5: mean of the five largest Tanimoto similarities to a reference space
distance_definitions.joint_model_distance: D5 to the connectivity-deduplicated 443+63 model-reference union
distance_definitions.joint_evidence_distance: D5 to the connectivity-deduplicated 443+84 evidence-reference union

reference_adaptive.threshold_source: leave-one-connectivity-out D5 distribution within each frozen reference space

structure_only_strata.dual_OOD: D5_primary > primary-reference Q80 and D5_direct_model > direct-model-reference Q80
structure_only_strata.external_quintiles: five equal-frequency groups of Biogen D5_joint_model, formed without using outcomes

kmeans_OOD20.algorithm: MiniBatchKMeans on Biogen ECFP4 binary vectors
kmeans_OOD20.selection: rank clusters by median D5_joint_model and include whole clusters until at least 20% of external rows are selected

structural_dependency.primary_bootstrap_cluster: existing Murcko scaffold; acyclic compounds separated by connectivity
structural_dependency.sensitivity_bootstrap_cluster: Butina clusters on Biogen ECFP4 with distance cutoff 0.60 (similarity 0.40)

reported_layers: frozen full-coverage p>=0.5 weak binary interface
v0.4-abstained rows forced through the p>=0.5 interface

distance_error: Spearman D5_joint_model versus per-row Brier loss
contrasts: accepted minus forced-rejected BAcc and MCC within OOD pressure sets

go_no_go.gate_distance_marks_failure: 95% CI lower bound for Spearman(D5, Brier loss)>0 and 95% CI upper bound for full-BAcc(extreme minus ID-like)<0
go_no_go.gate_rejector_responds_to_shift: 95% CI upper bound for coverage(extreme minus ID-like)<0
go_no_go.gate_OOD_accepted_reliability: in at least one predeclared OOD pressure set with adequate counts, accepted-minus-forced-rejected BAcc CI lower>0, accepted BAcc CI lower>0.5, accepted MCC CI lower>0, and coverage>=0.05

interpretation_boundaries: Murcko-scaffold cleaning is a sensitivity analysis, not proof of strict OOD generalization.
This retrospective analysis cannot be called prospective or outcome-unseen OOD validation.
Structural distance is not a mechanistic ABCB1 distance.
No result may be used to retune v0.4 or promote a post-hoc variant without a new outcome-unseen source.
No claim of ADC-release-species or intact-ADC OOD accuracy is permitted.
Coverage must always be reported with accepted-set performance.
